description_en: Enables or modifies the database proxy feature for an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于开启或者修改RDS实例的数据库代理实例功能
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-proxy --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --config-db-proxy-service Startup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBProxy

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the database proxy feature. Valid values:

Startup: enables the feature.
Shutdown: disables the feature.
Modify: modifies the configuration of the feature
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭数据库代理，取值：

Startup：开启代理服务
Shutdown：关闭代理服务
Modify：修改代理服务
parameters.name: config_db_proxy_service

parameters.help_en:
The number of proxy instances that are enabled. Valid values: 1 to 16. Default value: 1.

The capability of the database proxy to process requests increases with the number of proxy instances that are enabled. You can monitor the load on the instance and specify an appropriate number of proxy instances based on the load monitoring data
parameters.help_zh:
开通代理实例数量，取值：1~16。默认值：1。

更多的代理实例能处理更多的请求，您可以根据监控数据了解代理实例的负载，然后设置合理的代理实例数量
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_num

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Only the VPC network type is supported. Set the value to VPC.

If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络类型。当前仅支持VPC网络，取值：VPC。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the ID.

If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属VPC ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance belongs. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the ID.

If you enable the database proxy feature for the instance, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例所属虚拟交换机ID。可调用DescribeDBInstanceAttribute接口查询。

开启数据库代理时，该参数必选
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: A deprecated parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.name: db_proxy_engine_type

parameters.help_en:
The database proxy type. Valid values:

common: general-purpose database proxy
exclusive (default): dedicated database proxy
parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理实例类型，取值：
common：通用型代理
exclusive：独享型代理（默认值）
parameters.name: db_proxy_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable persistent connections. Valid values:

Enabled
Disabled



This parameter is available only for instances that run MySQL.

If you want to modify persistent connections, you must set the ConfigDBProxyService parameter to Modify
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启连接保持。取值：
Enabled：开启连接保持
Disabled：关闭连接保持

仅RDS MySQL支持此参数。
修改连接保持状态时，ConfigDBProxyService取值为Modify
parameters.name: persistent_connection_status

fields.help_en:
The number of CPU cores of the node. Valid values: 1 to 16.

This parameter is required when you configure the DBProxyNodes parameter
fields.help_zh:
节点CPU核数，取值1~16。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: cpu_cores

fields.help_en:
The number of proxy nodes in the zone. Valid values: 1 and 2.

This parameter is required when you configure the DBProxyNodes parameter
fields.help_zh:
可用区中代理节点数量，取值1~2。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: node_counts

fields.help_en:
The ID of the zone in which the node resides.

This parameter is required when you configure the DBProxyNodes parameter
fields.help_zh:
节点所在的可用区 ID。
选择DBProxyNodes时，该参数必选
fields.name: zone_id
